g.text: Hold PGM, pulse RESET, release PGM to enter the UART bootloader.
Normal start: RESET only. Do not short the EN pull-up resistor.

g.text: Power the device through J1; do not join two supply outputs.
Signal direction is authoritative: adapter connector labels may vary.
UART log: 115200 baud. GPIO1 = ESP TX; GPIO3 = ESP RX.

g.text: Equivalent circuit inside the LCDWIKI module (not extra parts).
LEDA is supplied by the module +3V3 rail.
GPIO4 -> DS1 pin 8 directly; HIGH enables the backlight.
Firmware PWM: 5 kHz / 10 bit. No external NPN is fitted here.
DS1 pin 8 is a logic input, not the raw LED anode.
Optional R3: PWM low at reset.
